candidate.O9_family: privilege escalation via unchecked pod-spec passthrough (CWE-269/284/693, missing authorization on security-sensitive fields)
candidate.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add hostNetwork/hostPID/privileged checks for spec.runtime.podspec in Environment.Validate only, leaving builder podspec, Function podspec, UPDATE verb, the merge layer, the runtime/builder Container fields, function sidecars, the serialized runtime override, the annotation exemption, the namespace pod overlay and the legacy version-1 restoration open.

verified.exploit_entry_point: Validating admission webhooks (pkg/webhook Environment/Function via GenericWebhook.ValidateCreate/ValidateUpdate) admit tenant objects carrying host namespaces, privileged/escalating containers, SYS_ADMIN, hostPath, a chosen service account, unsafe extra containers, a serialized runtime override, an annotation exemption, a namespace-level pod overlay loaded from a ConfigMap and a legacy version-1 restoration; the controllers (poolmgr genDeploymentSpec, newdeploy getDeploymentSpec, container getDeploymentSpec, buildermgr createBuilderDeployment) put them on the pods created from stored objects. Locally: every security testcase fails on the injected pinned tree by assertion, and every functional testcase passes.
